comparisonEvidence.mainObservation: Empowered Eye Beam expires without either ray starting in 13/22 windows; these follow a ray shortly before the empowerment application. This supports improving Hunt/ray sequencing rather than merely increasing cooldown count.
comparisonEvidence.limitations: Comparison damage loss is not fully attributable to this sequencing; gear, route, deaths, targets and phase context also differ.
